Based on the image provided, here is the QA check of the offer flyer:

**1) Logo Lockup Description**
The logo consists of a large, stylized serif letter **"K"** in gold. To its right is the wordmark **"KOZY CARE"** in white, uppercase sans-serif letters. Below the wordmark is the sub-brand text **"PREMIUM DRYCLEANING & LAUNDRY"** in smaller, gold, uppercase sans-serif letters with wide tracking (letter-spacing).

**2) Value-Prop Chips (Exact Quote)**
*   **FREE PICKUP & DELIVERY\***
*   **EXPRESS FROM 24 HOURS**
*   **EXPERT GARMENT CARE**

**3) Asterisked Fine Print (Exact Quote)**
"*Free pickup and delivery for first order only. Express service from 24 hours – regular service is 3–5 days."

**4) Contact Block Addresses**
There are **2** physical addresses listed:
1.  **No 20, Westsyde Drive, Ogombo, Lagos**
2.  **Paradise 3 Estate, Road 5/3, Chevron, Lagos**
*(Note: There is also an email address: kozygarmentcare@gmail.com)*

**5) Layout Problems / Clipping**
**No**, there do not appear to be any text clipping, overflow, or layout problems. All text elements, including the large "15% OFF" headline and the addresses at the bottom right, appear fully contained within the canvas boundaries with adequate padding. The layout looks clean and intentional.
